scope: Independent final-ISO readback of all 154 selected story chunks and 91,746 dialogue, condition, and speaker entries, plus reviewed save/load overviews, pilot-name, button-prompt, title-idle work-title and speaker-name overlays, 21x3 layout, runtime-token, and font checks; this is not a full gameplay playthrough.

dynamic_condition_update_audit.method: check every translated condition variant against the final decoded STAGE, including its original direct text offset
